tasks.description: Calculate daily AQI trends and classify air quality as Good/Moderate/Unhealthy using standard AQI thresholds.
Identify the primary pollutant contributing to elevated AQI levels using weightage factors for different pollutants.
Detect hourly pollution peaks using moving average comparison (window=3) and flag periods with 2+ consecutive high readings.
Infer pollution sources (traffic/industrial/agricultural) based on relative concentrations of CO, NO2, and PM2.5.
Map pollutant concentrations (e.g., PM2.5, O3) to health risk levels using WHO guidelines for respiratory and cardiovascular hazards.
Analyze monthly pollution patterns to identify seasonal variations in AQI and key pollutant concentrations.
Detect sudden spikes in PM2.5 or NO2 levels (above 95th percentile) that may indicate industrial events or wildfires.
